psychological_meaning: Russett evokes feelings of warmth, comfort, and stability. It is associated with the earth, nature, and autumn, suggesting a sense of groundedness and reliability. This color often represents a connection to the past and a sense of tradition, while also conveying a subtle sense of sophistication and understated elegance.
